findings.title: WordPress 7.1.4 Security Release - Patchstack
findings.summary_md: Patchstack reports WordPress 7.1.4 released on 28 October 2026 fixing 22 vulnerabilities across 17 advisories, with same-day backports to every supported branch down to 4.7.39. The timeline notes the upgrade-window RCE was added to the Patchstack Database on 28 October 2026, two days before the first news mention on 30 October.

findings.title: WordPress 7.1.4 News Post - WordPress.org
findings.summary_md: The official WordPress News post with article:published_time 2026-10-28T17:13:02+00:00 announces release 7.1.4 as a security release. It recommends immediate updates but does not detail the upgrade-window RCE mechanism in the public post body.
